notes: Diverse weight averaging (Rame et al., 2022): a shared initialization obtained by linear probing (head trained on the frozen ImageNet backbone), then `runs` fine-tunings from it with mildly randomized hyperparameters (learning rate below the base one, weight decay, dropout) for the base number of epochs without early stopping; the network deployed is the uniform average of their weights (variant 'uniform', DiWA's main method) or the greedy restricted average in order of selection score ('restricted'), with batch-normalization statistics re-estimated on training images afterwards. One network at every budget. Base recipe as in every baseline otherwise. Paths are relative to the repository root.
